note: Recognition questions for the script units that have no Davidson exercises (6, 9-12), written for this course from the lesson and the Davidson section in `section` (grammar page `page`, linked as the scan). Each question becomes rung 1 (true/false: `claim` with the answer or the first wrong option) and rung 2 (choose among `answer` + `wrong`); a question with `typed` also gets rung 3 (type the answer; `pointing: true` checks vowel points). `script` marks Hebrew options. No transliteration. Read by build/exwb_to_authored.py.
